profile.pageDescription: Personal details, interface language, password and organisation

info.title: About the profile
info.body: Name and language apply immediately. The email is used for sign-in and notifications — the organisation owner can change it via support.

profile.title: Personal details
profile.name: Name

password.title: Password
password.description: Change it if you suspect someone else knows it

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: A code from an authenticator app on every sign-in
twoFactor.enabledHint: You will be asked for an app code on sign-in
twoFactor.disabledHint: Two-factor authentication is enabled by an organisation administrator

tenant.title: Organisation
tenant.description: Name, timezone and default language for the whole team
tenant.name: Name

accounts.pageDescription: Connections to Yandex, Google, 2GIS and other sources

info.title: About accounts
info.body: A platform account gives the system access to your listings and reviews. When access is lost the listings move to «Action required» — reconnect the account.

accounts.hint: Connect an account on every platform where your listings live
accounts.oauthFailed: Could not connect the platform — try again
accounts.challengeHint: Sign in to the platform, pass its verification, then press «Check»

problems.title: {count, plural, one {# account needs attention} other {# accounts need attention}}
problems.body: Until access is restored the platform data is not refreshed

empty.title: No platforms connected
empty.hint: Connect an account to sync listings and receive reviews

accounts.removeConfirm: Disconnect «{name}»? {count, plural, =0 {No listings affected.} one {# listing will stop syncing.} other {# listings will stop syncing.}}

connect.title: Connect platform
connect.description: Choose a platform and how to connect

authHint.oauth: You will be taken to the platform to confirm access
authHint.partner_key: The key is issued by the platform in its partner cabinet
authHint.credentials: Stored in the secure vault and never shown again

notifications.pageDescription: Which events to send and through which channels

info.title: About notification settings
info.body: Settings are personal: every team member picks their own channels. Quiet hours postpone emails and pushes until the morning.

rules.title: Events
rules.description: Enable an event and tick the channels. A channel is available when it is enabled below.

email.title: Email
email.hint: Messages to the address from your profile

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.hint: Messages from the bot — link your account once

web_push.title: Browser push
web_push.hint: Notifications in this browser while the tab is closed

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.description: Emails and pushes are held and delivered after the period ends

integrations.pageDescription: API keys for your systems and event webhooks

info.title: About integrations
info.body: An API key is shown once, on creation — store it safely. Webhooks sign requests with a secret; the delivery log is kept for 30 days.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Platform API access for BI, CRM and other systems
keys.createHint: The name helps to tell keys apart in the log; scopes limit what the key can do
keys.name: Name
keys.createdHint: Copy the key now — it will not be shown again
keys.revokeConfirm: Revoke key «{name}»? Systems using it will lose access.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: HTTP notifications about events to your system
webhooks.hint: We send a POST with the event JSON and a signature header
webhooks.urlInvalid: The URL must start with https://
webhooks.deleteConfirm: Delete webhook {url}? Events will stop being sent.

sources.pageDescription: What to do when data diverges and which platforms to use

info.title: About field policies
info.body: When a platform changes listing data on its own (e.g. opening hours after a customer complaint), the field policy decides whose version wins.

policies.title: Field policies
policies.description: What to do when platform data differs from the data in the system

enforce.title: Our version wins
enforce.hint: Changes on the platform are overwritten

accept_platform.title: Accept the platform version
accept_platform.hint: The system is updated from the platform

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Disabled platforms are not synced and do not appear in reports
